body.heading: Where in the world is Ireland?
paragraphs: Ireland is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Ireland is Dublin.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Ireland speak Irish and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Ireland is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Ireland?
paragraphs: Ireland covers about 70,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Greece.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Cliffs of Moher rise 214 metres straight from the Atlantic, with seabirds wheeling below and views to the Aran Islands on clear days.
In Dublin, see the Book of Kells' illuminated pages in Trinity's Old Library, then explore Viking history and the deer of Phoenix Park.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
